headline: 6 more die in 24 hours as measles toll reaches 1,233 in Bangladesh
summary: The DGHS reports that over 222,000 people have developed symptoms of the disease this year, with Dhaka Division recording the highest number of deaths.
details: Six more people died from measles symptoms in a single day, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS). Deaths were recorded in Dhaka, Mymensingh, Barishal, and Khulna divisions.
Since March 15, the total death toll has reached 1,233. Of these, 1,129 died with symptoms and 104 cases were laboratory-confirmed.
Dhaka Division has been the hardest hit, recording 505 deaths among patients with symptoms, followed by Sylhet with 200 and Chattogram with 107.
In the last 24 hours alone, 1,388 people developed symptoms and 78 tested positive for the virus. Hospitals admitted 1,296 patients with symptoms across the country.
Between March 15 and Saturday, nearly 198,000 patients were admitted to hospitals with symptoms, and 190,036 have since recovered.

This year, 222,552 people have developed symptoms of measles, with 23,478 testing positive. The DGHS notes that the real number of confirmed cases is difficult to determine as not every patient is tested.

headline: 1 killed as fire breaks out at plastic factory in Keraniganj
summary: A man died of burns after a blaze hit the Aman Plastic Factory in Narikel Bagh. Seven firefighting units worked for two hours to bring the fire under control.
details: A man has died of burns after a fire broke out at the Aman Plastic Factory in Narikel Bagh of Dhaka’s Keraniganj on Monday.
Fire Service Headquarters spokesperson Talha Bin Zasim confirmed the death, noting that the victim has been identified as male, though his name and identity are yet to be confirmed.
The fire was reported around 12:25 pm. Firefighting units arrived at the scene seven minutes later and immediately launched extinguishing operations.
Seven firefighting units worked for nearly two hours to battle the blaze, eventually bringing it under control around 2:00 pm.
caption:
A man has died after a fire ripped through a plastic factory in Keraniganj.

A man has died of burns after a fire broke out at the Aman Plastic Factory in Narikel Bagh of Dhaka’s Keraniganj on Monday.

Fire Service Headquarters spokesperson Talha Bin Zasim confirmed the death, noting that the victim has been identified as male, though his name and identity are yet to be confirmed.

The fire was reported around 12:25 pm. Firefighting units arrived at the scene seven minutes later and immediately launched extinguishing operations.

Seven firefighting units worked for nearly two hours to battle the blaze, eventually bringing it under control around 2:00 pm.
